lines.text: This rescue rover is driven from far away. Its operator must never lose the link.

lines.text: Off the cable and straight onto Wi-Fi, without a moment offline.

lines.text: A normal rover without CONTINUA drives this same road at the same moment. Its status is beside ours, at the top.

lines.text: Ahead, a cutting blocks Wi-Fi and cellular. CONTINUA's road map saw it 79 m out and is warming up satellite.

lines.text: The banks close in: Wi-Fi and cellular fade out.

lines.text: CONTINUA is on satellite and still connected. The normal rover has lost its link.

lines.text: CONTINUA is on satellite and still connected, though its video pauses on the thinner link. The normal rover has lost its link.

lines.text: Wi-Fi and cellular are gone. CONTINUA is on satellite and still connected, though its video pauses on the thinner link.

lines.text: Through the cutting, CONTINUA never lost its link. The normal rover was cut off for 4.5 s and had to stop.

lines.text: The same road, 20 times. CONTINUA with its road map kept the link 20 times out of 20; the normal rover, 0. Keeping every network on also stayed connected, at about 3× the cost - and, with big uploads held back, for less than CONTINUA.
